entries.value: "User network store (SQLite store at ~/.base-studio-code/networks.db) for base-studio-code — a NETWORK is a domain that owns a set of projects and exactly one architect session. A thin network-specific shim over the shared bsc-json-store (#2158), reachable from the Tauri app's Glance tabs and the session-facing `bsc network` CLI. The ASSIGNMENT of a project to a network is not here — it is the `network` column on the project row in bsc-project, mirroring how `architect` already works."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly. NOT via bsc_graph: a build script must not depend
# on the crate graph it is part of, and load() reconciles the packaged seed into what it reads.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no SQLite) so the tiny CLI reuses it without dragging the whole desktop app
# in. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_network` crate name.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store + CLI scaffold (#2158) — this crate supplies only the
# network-specific nouns + lean `list` fields via a CliSpec.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `CmdDoc` for the per-command help catalog.
# The ONE home-dir resolver (#1646), for the custom `new`/`rename` verbs.
# `new`/`rename` compose and patch the stored row without a typed model.
